rubric_notes: Thorough, evidence-backed enumeration of a.22.1.1-a.22.1.4 with sunids, full TAF family membership (NC2, NF-Y, CHRAC, Sos), H1/H5 lineage in a.4.5, name-only enzyme hits, homology endpoints with no warnings, and careful limits. States superfamily-level probable common ancestry and family-level distinctions, and declines to call H1/H5 analogous. However it never explicitly states that family distinctions preclude transferring histone/nucleosome function to TAFs, archaeal or bacterial members (gold criterion 3). 'SCOPe asserts no homology' for H1/H5 is slightly overstated but immediately qualified. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Verified class/fold/superfamily/family sunids, family- and superfamily-level homology records, annotations and release scope. Correctly identifies the superfamily as the deepest shared homology node, no family-level claim, treats family/superfamily names as labels not functional assertions, rejects HisE reaction transfer, template interchangeability, shared oligomeric state or ligand mode, and notes absence of family link is not a negative homology claim. Complete.

Correct families with sunids (53068/53083/53089), superfamily 53067, fold c.55, all supported by bundle; homology record and superfamily duplication comment supported. Clear superfamily-level remote-ancestry inference with explicit limits on substrate, reaction, ligand, role, and template use. Useful supported caveat separating HSP70 peptide-binding (b.130.1) and C-terminal (a.8.4.1) domains from c.55.1. Domain examples d1rgia1/2 and d4foea1/2 supported. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. All identifiers (47240, 47239, 46456, 47241, 47253, 100951, 47257, 47263, 47244, 47246, 63524) verified by parents/children/search in bundle; homology flags, bimetal comment, Pfam mapping, empty 'ribonucleotide reductase' search and release labels all supported. Interpretation: superfamily is the deepest homology-bearing level so common ancestry is asserted; family split records divergence; chemistry flagged as unverified background; no template transfer; explicitly names required outside evidence (superposition of metal-ligand residues, sequence correspondence, biochemical data).

Correctly places b.6.1.1 (49504), b.6.1.5 (74874), b.6.1.6 (110107) in superfamily b.6.1 (49503) under fold b.6; interprets superfamily placement as probable shared ancestry of the scaffold, not shared biochemistry. Uses retrieved annotations (superfamily 'contains copper-binding site'; ephrin and PAD4 families 'lacking the metal-binding site') to reject copper transfer, and requires metal ligand residues, metal content or binding/redox measurements before inferring copper binding or electron transfer. All identifiers and annotations supported by the bundle; limits stated honestly. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Fold, superfamily, three families with sunids, Pfam, member lists, homology records, Ubx homeodomain name collision (a.4.1.1) and 'not a true protein' automated-match annotation all supported by the bundle; superfamily-level ancestry not function; rejects ubiquitin-pathway, Ras-binding-for-every-member and p97/VCP transfers. Overly cautious about ubiquitin placement despite its own d.15.1.1 children list containing Ubiquitin (54238), but no error. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Thorough: all three families under c.23.1 with sunids, empty homology warnings, 'lacks canonical receiver domains features' caveat applied, linker note read as non-functional; superfamily read as remote common ancestry, fold as structural only. Rejects receiver signaling, decarboxylase/PLP catalysis, template use, and convergence claims. Unsupported claim: states the API lists no domain-level member under the ODC-wing family, but it only retrieved family and protein children and never queried the species node 52254, so this is not established by the evidence.

Correct b.84.5/b.84.5.1 under b.84 with sibling superfamilies, sunids, species node and d3a5ca3 boundary all bundle-supported; homology records cited. States ancestry claim among b.84.5 members, fold-only relation to b.84.1-b.84.4, and that no analogy/convergence is implied; function and template limits given; release scope stated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct f.21 fold and three superfamilies with sunids; fold homology warning, fold core comment, f.21.1/f.21.2/f.21.3 annotations and f.21.1 family list all bundle-supported. States no positive superfamily assertion, explicitly not proof of being unrelated/convergent, treats possible-link note as needing alignment evidence, and disambiguates cytochrome c' in a.24 as a different fold. Minor imprecision: reports an empty 'nitrate reductase' search where the bundle shows 'nitrate reductase gamma'. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All three families (c.2.1.1/51736, c.2.1.8/51900, c.2.1.9/63944) correctly placed under superfamily c.2.1 (51735), fold c.2, class c; homology/annotation records match bundle. Correctly reads superfamily as probable remote common ancestry, denies family-level closeness, refuses to transfer cofactor/reaction/function, flags family names as labels, and notes the N-terminal-domain curator comment. Background cofactor statement explicitly flagged as unverified. No must_avoid violation. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Retrieves and reports the 'not a true family' annotation on family SUNID 100905, correctly notes it qualifies the family-level inference, and states designed-protein lineage does not establish natural evolutionary origin. All identifiers and annotations are bundle-supported, including protein-node annotation checks. Reasoning slightly overreaches by relocating the 'strongest' homology claim to superfamily k.40.1 as uncaveated, without noting that this superfamily is the same designed grouping, which dilutes the required 'designed structural grouping with homology caveat' framing. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete and fully bundle-supported: 1.69 d1t1ja_/d1t1jb_ c.137.1.1 with lineage c.137 > c.137.1 > c.137.1.1 (sunids 110459-110461); 2.08 d1t1ja1/d1t1jb1 (1-118) c.23.14.2 under c.23 > c.23.14 (52309); 1f8y c.23.14.1 in both releases. States SCOPe now asserts probable common ancestry at superfamily level, no family-level relationship, no substrate/activity transfer; notes l.1.1.1 extra domains and periodic update label. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct SUNID, SCCS, artifact lineage, homology warning, homology_implied_by_level=false, and annotation record, all supported by bundle; d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 VH lineage given from parents endpoint. Rejects using the tag as any homology example and states limits (sequence not retrieved, no chain comparison run, warning is not evidence of non-homology elsewhere). Complete.

Complete: 1.75 one domain f.11.1.1, single in 2.01-2.03, split at 2.04 and persisting through 2.08 into d1acca1 f.60.1.1 226-735 and d1acca2 b.179.1.1 14-225, with full lineages. Correctly flags the f.11/f.60 name overlap as not homology, states SCOPe does not assert the modules are unrelated, and gives sound per-domain search guidance. Bundle supports all releases.

All five domains with SIDs, boundaries, full lineages; d3jb9a5 fold d.394 as new fold, a4 bromodomain family closest link, a1-a3 superfamily-level; mosaic read in sequence order; checks 2.07 persistence (bundle supports); clear function-transfer limits and release scope. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete: family placement, repeat-count-driven length, and the 're' heterogeneity plus representative repeat, with the family-node homology_scope 'fa' correctly supported by the 267609 homology response in its bundle. Separates verified classification from background DNA-binding knowledge and withholds function transfer. Release and lineage facts are accurate and well evidenced.

Correct metadata supported by bundle; cites stable 2.08 as release selector; says periodic update does not replace stable release. Refers to 'the skill's guidance' rather than public documentation, a minor provenance weakness. Does not explain that periodic updates add newly classified PDB entries without rewriting stable-release domains. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Most thorough release history: 1.75 and 2.01 annotations (including the dropped 'mutant' comment and the 1.75 sunid 17771 for d1dn1b_ vs 302344 in 2.08), the 2.08 'ms' flag, automated-matches provenance, and the periodic-update check are all bundle-supported. However the claims that 1dn1 was unclassified in 2.01 and that 1dn1B clusters to 3c98B at 100% identity over 267 residues have no supporting response in the bundle. Interpretation correctly limits fragment calls to a partial three-helix region and warns against complete-domain template use; does not state that the full domain resolves the fragment-driven spectrin-like resemblance. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. All must_include met: convergence of binding sites from functional constraint, divergence asserted only within superfamily (c.2.1), homology requires superposition/topology, sequence/profile, phylogeny, domain architecture. Explicitly refuses to call c.2.1 vs d.58.20.1 convergent or nonhomologous from placement alone and states SCOPe cannot decide. All identifiers (51735/51734, 51905/51904, 52467/52466, 63984, 111331, 55036/55035) and the c.31.1 reversed-cofactor comment are verified in the bundle. Pretrained claim about NAD kinase substrate is flagged. No material issue.

Gives 2.04 fold-level difference, 2.08 shared superfamily b.18.1 with different families, superfamily-level common ancestry with caveats, no shared function. Correct classifications and the 2.04-to-2.05 timing; honestly flags that the API gives no curation rationale. Avoids all must_avoid items.

All must_include met: family placement still supports homology; hf defined as different fold from exemplar despite similar sequence and secondary-structure count; coordinates/topology not transferable and d1ztra1 should be stratified or excluded with flag preserved. Notes exemplar not named, mutant and nhe-complex comments, and no function transfer. Release 2.08, sunids 94286/125655/46690/46691/46692, lineage, comments, and homology fields all match the evidence bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22. Full verified lineage with sunids, boundaries, fr annotation semantics (domain scope, not inherited, in heterogeneity list, no warnings), distinct protein nodes (110060 vs 49267). Alignment: covered region only, mask missing portion, do not read global score as similarity for missing part. Representative: exclude fragments or place in separate stratum; explicitly declines SPACI ranking since quality not retrieved. Diversity counted by dm nodes with fragments reported separately; family children list and has_more=false are bundle-supported. Rejects cr9/function/template transfer. All must_include met, no must_avoid violated.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. New superfamily if global alignment shows matching topology; family rejected as asserting superfamily-level ancestry; new fold as structural-novelty claim contradicted by resemblance; explicitly refuses 'unrelated/analogous/convergent' labels; single-member superfamily provisional; curation as manual step; absence-of-evidence caveat. Release list, stable label, periodic update and hierarchy levels all supported by the bundled responses.

All verified facts (fold 56111, class 53931, superfamily 56112 with no warnings and the ATP-grasp/PIPK comment, families 88854/56171/64411, protein 103302, empty text searches) match the bundle; the comment is correctly treated as non-classificatory. Superfamily placement interpreted as probable common ancestry at that level with no close family-level relationship; shared architecture binding nucleotide and transferring phosphoryl, with motif details flagged as hypotheses. Explicitly denies shared substrate specificity, regulation, inhibitors or templates from superfamily or family placement. Required evidence includes same-release lineages, catalytic-domain boundary checks, alignment of substrate-binding and catalytic residues, biochemical assays, substrate-bound structures, and regulatory-partner/domain-architecture evidence; also notes quality values are needed before template ranking. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.
